T2: sum over size-two clusters C of sum_{j in C} i^j; same site origin as A and L
projection: P_sign is the stationary-L2 orthogonal projector onto the same Kreweras ray
orthogonal_normalization: eta=(t_sign-e<e,t_sign>)/norm(t_sign-e<e,t_sign>); positive real norm, no phase rotation
cross_convention: C_fg(s)=<f,exp(sG)g>_pi; anti-Hermitian difference A_fg=C_fg-conj(C_gf), without a factor 1/2
controls: G* gives the negative by algebra; S gives zero by self-adjointness; neither is separately solved
execution: one named pair only, deterministic local single thread; no fitting, observable scan, MC, new width or test campaign
